rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to previously mentioned knowledge
inclusive particle extending the action to the disciple
first member of compound with paṅkaje
locus of realization; second member of compound with śīrṣa

items.question: In what bodily locus does the disciple enact that transmitted knowledge?
premises: That knowledge is the object enacted by the disciple.
The disciple is included as an agent of this enactment.
The head-lotus functions as the locus of this enactment.
items.inference: The disciple also enacts that knowledge within the head-lotus.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taj jñānaṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: O goddess, the disciple also realizes that knowledge in the lotus of the head.
